title: Requirements for UE in a PLMN

entities.name: PLMN-specific attempt counters for 3GPP access
entities.description: List of counters maintained by UE for access attempts via 3GPP access. Maximum number of entries is implementation dependent.

entities.name: PLMN-specific attempt counters for non-3GPP access
entities.description: List of counters maintained by UE for access attempts via non-3GPP access. Only present if UE supports non-3GPP access.

entities.name: PLMN-specific N1 mode attempt counters for 3GPP access
entities.description: List of counters for N1 mode access attempts via 3GPP access.

entities.name: PLMN-specific N1 mode attempt counters for non-3GPP access
entities.description: List of counters for N1 mode access attempts via non-3GPP access. Only present if UE supports non-3GPP access.

entities.name: Counter for SIM/USIM considered invalid for GPRS services
entities.description: Event counter for when SIM/USIM is considered invalid for GPRS services.

entities.name: Counter for USIM considered invalid for 5GS services over non-3GPP access
entities.description: Event counter for when USIM is considered invalid for 5GS services over non-3GPP access. Only present if UE supports non-3GPP access.

entities.name: Timer T3247
entities.description: Timer started when UE receives unprotected REGISTRATION REJECT or SERVICE REJECT with certain 5GMM cause values. Duration is random between 30-60 minutes.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE
entities.description: UE state entered when certain unprotected reject messages are received with specific 5GMM cause values.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REJECT
entities.description: NAS message that can trigger UE actions when received without integrity protection.

entities.name: SERVICE REJECT
entities.description: NAS message that can trigger UE actions when received without integrity protection.

entities.name: Unprotected REGISTRATION REJECT or SERVICE REJECT
entities.description: Condition where UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT or SERVICE REJECT without integrity protection before secure NAS exchange established.

entities.name: Store counters in non-volatile memory
entities.description: UE requirement to store attempt counters and event counters in non-volatile memory.

relations.description: UE starts timer T3247 when receiving unprotected REGISTRATION REJECT or SERVICE REJECT with specified 5GMM cause values.
UE enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE state when receiving unprotected reject with certain 5GMM cause values.
Unprotected REGISTRATION REJECT message triggers UE actions including starting T3247 and state transition.
Unprotected SERVICE REJECT message triggers UE actions including starting T3247 and state transition.
PLMN-specific attempt counters for 3GPP access are stored in non-volatile memory.
PLMN-specific attempt counters for non-3GPP access are stored in non-volatile memory.
Upon T3247 expiry, UE sets USIM to valid for 5GS services if counter value is below maximum.
Upon T3247 expiry, UE sets USIM to valid for 5GS services over non-3GPP access if counter value is below maximum.
